senses.gloss: (denom. of קְרִיץ, קְרִיצְתָּא) to get up early, to do a thing early. Y. Ter. XI, end, 48ᵇ ע״י כן הוה שהר … הוה ק׳ through that (burning lamp) he was wakeful, and through that he arose early; Y. Sabb. II, 4ᵈ top.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 5:4:5">Y. Ab. Zar. V, 44ᵈ</cite> <he>נִקְרוֹץ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="O00200"><he>סְדַר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 5:4:5">Ib.</cite> <he>וק׳ ונפק ליה</he> he got up early and went off.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 25:5">Lev. R. s. 25</cite> <he>אי קַרְצַת לא חשכת</he> if thou hadst worked early (while young), thou wouldst not have to work late (in old age).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 25">Ib.</cite> <he>קַרְצִית וחשכית</he> (not <he>קריצת</he>) I did work early, and do work late.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 32">Lev. R. s. 32</cite> <he>ק׳ נוגש וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>קדם</he>), v. <cite ref="N00196"><he>נָגַשׂ</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 3:3">Lam. R. to III, 7</cite> <he>לא הוה בר נש קָרֵיץ לתאיניא וכ׳</he> (not <he>לתאינה</he>) and none came in the morning to gather the figs earlier than they; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 5:2:4">Y. Maas. Sh. V, 56ᵃ</cite> top.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 3:4:4">Y. Kidd. III, 64ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ זבונה וכ׳</he> the trader got up early &c., v. <cite ref="S02101"><he>קְרַן</he></cite>; a. fr.
